subject: HealthSync kickoff — proposed time, attendee roster & join links
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Dana Li <dana.li@healthsync.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthsync.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthSync kickoff — proposed time, attendee roster & join links

Hi Dana / Tom —

Great to meet you earlier this week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in a 60-minute kickoff to cover launch scope, roles, success criteria, and next steps. Proposed windows (all PT):

- Thu Jun 18, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu Jun 18, 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Fri Jun 19, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Agenda (draft) — attached as "HealthSync-kickoff-agenda-v1.pdf":
- 5m: Introductions & outcomes
- 20m: Solution overview and scope (Redwood)
- 15m: Customer goals, data, and security touchpoints (HealthSync)
- 10m: Implementation plan & milestones
- 10m: Action items & owners

Attendees we plan to include from our side: Markus (launch lead), Kimberly (implementation PM), Monica (solutions/CS), Ben (technical ops). Can you confirm the core stakeholders you want on the call, and whether we should include procurement or security? If Jun 18 works, we can send an invite with a bridge and a calendar .ics.

Also, one ask before kickoff: please share the SSO point of contact and any calendar domains that require special handling, plus whether you prefer Teams or Zoom for the meeting link.

Attaching agenda + a placeholder .ics. If you prefer I send a Microsoft Teams link, we can swap.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Implementation | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments: HealthSync-kickoff-agenda-v1.pdf, kickoff-bridge.ics

From: Dana Li <dana.li@healthsync.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@healthsync.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: HealthSync kickoff — proposed time, attendee roster & join links

Thanks Markus —

Jun 18 at 10:00 AM PT works best for us. Please invite these folks from HealthSync:
- Sara O'Neal (Product Owner) — sara.oneal@healthsync.com
- Alan Chen (Security Lead) — alan.chen@healthsync.com
- procurement@healthsync.com (we'll have procurement on the call for initial commercial alignment)

We prefer Teams for internal calendar links. Also flagging that our domain has a strict external calendar policy; if you can send the meeting invite from a redwood.com address (which I see you will), that should be fine.

Two quick notes:
1) For the SSO / SAML discussion, Alan will want a short pre-read on what config items we'll ask for (metadata, SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated, test accounts).
2) Sara will circulate a short list of initial datasets and privacy constraints before the call.

Can you confirm and send a Teams link + updated agenda?

Best,
Dana Li
Director of Product Operations | HealthSync
Dana.Li@healthsync.com
